description: Ice and control - and, for those who learn it, the Light held in frozen form.

nodes.name: Frostbite
nodes.description: Your Frost spells have a 5% chance per rank to freeze the target for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Gives your Chill effects a 5%/10%/15% chance to freeze the target for 5 sec.' Built as a real stun - is_stun is this engine's only incapacitate and is exactly what 'freeze the target' means. DEPARTURE on the source: there are no Chill effects to attach to, so it fires on any Frost damage cast. icd 1 holds it to once a turn. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict and no proc - it did nothing for 3 points.

nodes.name: Improved Frostbolt
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Frostbolt by 3% per rank and its critical chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1-0.5 sec.' DEPARTURE - no cast times. A shorter cast is more throughput, so it is delivered as damage plus a little crit. Kept from the outgoing tree at the same values.

nodes.name: Ice Floes
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova, Cone of Cold and Icy Veins by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Block and Icy Veins spells by 7%/13%/20%.' Ice Block does not exist; the other three do. Authored as FLAT turns rather than the real percentage because _cooldown_pct would compound awkwardly across three different cooldowns. talented_cooldown clamps at 1 turn.

nodes.name: Ice Shards
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Standardised 6 Nov: every caster tree carries one 5-point spell-crit-damage talent worth +100% at full rank, matching priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury (both WoW-accurate). Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.'

nodes.name: Piercing Ice
nodes.description: Increases your Frost spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%/4%/6%.' USES THE PER-SCHOOL KEY DELIBERATELY. frost_spell_damage is built as f'{school}_spell_damage' at abilities.py:1371, so a literal grep cannot see it - the exact family that caused arcane_spell_damage to be WRONGLY declared dead in this project, published in a commit and a doc before correction. It is LIVE and it is the right key for a school-scoped talent. The outgoing version used the school-agnostic spell_damage, which also lifted the mage's Fire and Arcane damage.

nodes.name: Frost Warding
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your Ice Barrier by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the armor and resistances given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 25%/50%.' DEPARTURE - neither Armor spell exists as a distinct Frost spell (mage_armor is generic). Ice Barrier is this tree's real protective spell, so the potency lands there. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Icy Veins
nodes.description: Teaches Icy Veins, hastening your casting.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, kept - the ONLY unlock for mage_icy_veins, which is requires_talent. Its pushback-reduction clause has nothing to act on.

nodes.name: Elemental Precision
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 1% per rank and reduces your spell costs by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1 ('Precision'): 'Reduces the mana cost and increases your chance to hit with spells by 1%/2%/3%.' Built with BOTH halves, where the outgoing version had hit_rating alone. The display name keeps the outgoing tree's 'Elemental Precision' so nothing referring to it by name breaks. all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION and FLIPS to points inside a status effect.

nodes.name: Permafrost
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your Blizzard and Frost Nova by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 1-3 secs, reduces the target's speed by an additional 4%-10%.' DEPARTURE - there are no Chill effects and no movement speed. Delivered as duration on the tree's two control spells, which is the nearest real reading. ability_<id>_duration is FLAT turns and POSITIVE EXTENDS. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Arctic Reach
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Ice Lance and Blizzard by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, Deep Freeze and Blizzard spells.' DEPARTURE - there is no range. A longer reach is more casts landed, so it is delivered as damage on the two of the four that are not already covered by Improved Frostbolt. The outgoing version granted flat frost_spell_power, which is Piercing Ice's territory.

nodes.name: Frost Channeling
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your spells by 3% per rank and the threat they generate by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim with both halves: 'Reduces the mana cost of all spells by 4%/7%/10% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 4%/7%/10%.' There is no per-school threat key, only the global threat_generation_pct, which is a FRACTION. Stacks with Elemental Precision on cost. The outgoing version was flat per-ability cost cuts.

nodes.name: Cold Snap
nodes.description: Teaches Cold Snap, finishing the cooldown on your Frost spells.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, kept - the ONLY unlock for mage_cold_snap, which is requires_talent. It is Ice Barrier's and Cold as Ice's prerequisite in the real tree, both preserved below.

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against frozen targets by 17%/34%/50%.' DEPARTURE - NOTHING in this engine reads a debuff on the target, so 'against frozen targets' cannot be checked. Delivered unconditionally at a far smaller value, since it is now always on rather than situational. Frost's whole frozen-target identity runs into this wall - see also Fingers of Frost and Deep Freeze. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Improved Cone of Cold
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Cone of Cold by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 15%/25%/35%.' 12% per rank reaches 36%, the nearest whole percent per rank.

nodes.name: Frozen Core
nodes.description: Reduces spell damage taken by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim: 'Reduces the damage taken from all spells by 2%/4%/6%.' spell_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and NEGATIVE reduces. The outgoing version used low_health_damage_reduction_pct AND low_health_threshold_pct, which is a different talent entirely (Fiery Payback, in Fire) and put this class one node from a summing-threshold breach.

nodes.name: Cold as Ice
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Cold Snap and Ice Barrier by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Cold Snap, Ice Barrier and Summon Water Elemental spells by 10%/20%.' Summon Water Elemental does not exist. The real talent requires Cold Snap, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Winter's Chill
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Frostbolt by 1% per rank and your Frost spell damage by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Increases your chance to critically hit with Frostbolt by an additional 1%/2%/3% and gives your Frost damage spells a chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, increasing the chance of a critical strike against the target.' The self-crit half is built; the target-debuff half needs something to read a debuff on the target, which does not exist, so a small Frost damage bonus stands in. The outgoing version was flat spell_damage.

nodes.name: Shattered Barrier
nodes.description: Your Ice Barrier has a 50% chance per rank to freeze nearby enemies for 1 turn.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Gives your Ice Barrier spell a 50%/100% chance to freeze all enemies within 10 yds for 8 sec when it is destroyed.' DEPARTURE on the trigger - there is no event for an absorb shield being CONSUMED or an effect EXPIRING, so it fires when the barrier is CAST instead. A 1-turn stun rather than 8 seconds, because a stun that lands on cast rather than on break is far easier to arrange. The real talent requires Ice Barrier, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Ice Barrier
nodes.description: Teaches Ice Barrier, shielding you in ice.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for mage_ice_barrier, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Cold Snap, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Empowered Frostbolt
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Frostbolt by 5% per rank and its critical chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Increases the damage of your Frostbolt spell by an amount equal to 5%/10% of your spell power and reduces its cast time.' Spell-power coefficients are not exposed to talents and there are no cast times, so it is direct damage plus crit. Kept from the outgoing tree, which ALSO carried frost_spell_power=40 inside a proc's stat_mods - verified live as readable, so that was not the dead-key problem, but it is dropped here as duplicating Piercing Ice.

nodes.name: Arctic Winds
nodes.description: Increases your Frost spell damage by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Increases all Frost damage you cause by 1%-5% and reduces the chance melee and ranged attacks will hit you.' The damage half is built verbatim with the per-school key. There is no caster-side miss chance for INCOMING attacks - hit_chance_spell is a dead talent key, set once in Character.__init__. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Fingers of Frost
nodes.description: Your Frost spells have a 7% chance per rank to grant a guaranteed critical strike window.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Gives your Chill effects a 7%/15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells as if the target were frozen.' DEPARTURE - nothing reads whether a target is frozen, so 'as if frozen' has no referent. What being frozen BUYS in the real game is Shatter's enormous crit bonus, so this grants crit chance directly - which is the same payoff by the only route the engine has. 'Next 2 spells' becomes a 2-turn window. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Brain Freeze
nodes.description: Your Frost spells have a 5% chance per rank to make your next spells cheaper and sharper for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your Frost damage spells with chilling effects have a 5%/10%/15% chance to cause your next Fireball or Frostfire Bolt spell to be instant cast and cost no mana.' DEPARTURE - no cast times and no Frostfire Bolt. The 'cost no mana' clause IS buildable and is the real payoff, so all_ability_cost_pct 100 inside the status effect makes the window free. MIND THE FLIP: that key is PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect and a FRACTION as a talent effect. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Chilled to the Bone
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Frostbolt and Ice Lance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases the damage caused by your Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt and Ice Lance spells by 1%-5% and reduces the movement speed of all chilled targets.' Frostfire Bolt does not exist and there is no movement speed. The outgoing version was flat spell_damage.

nodes.name: Deep Freeze
nodes.description: Your Frost spells have a 5% chance per rank to stun the target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10 in the real tree, moved here: 'Stuns the target for 5 sec. Only usable on Frozen targets.' DEPARTURE - there is no mage_deep_freeze ability to unlock, and 'only usable on Frozen targets' cannot be checked. Delivered as a chance to stun off any Frost cast, with icd 2 so it is not permanent control. It sits at tier 5 rather than 6 because the capstone row belongs to the Cryotherapist's Frostfall. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Cryobolt
nodes.description: Your Frostbolt also heals your neediest ally for part of the damage it deals.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. This is the entry point of the healing branch and the reason the Cryotherapist works at all.

nodes.name: Cryolance
nodes.description: Your Ice Lance also heals your neediest ally for part of the damage it deals.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. The second entry point; both feed Spirit Frost.

nodes.name: Spirit Frost
nodes.description: Every heal you cast returns 40 Mana.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. Its effects dict is empty and all its work is in the proc, which is legitimate.

nodes.name: Cryotherapy
nodes.description: Increases your healing by 5% per rank. Your heals also have a 33% chance per rank to spill over, healing your neediest ally for a further 60.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. Carries BOTH effects and a proc, which the engine supports and which this node is the clearest example of in the project.

nodes.name: Cryotherapist
nodes.description: Increases your healing by 10%. Your damaging spells now mend as they wound, healing your neediest ally for 50.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. The branch's keystone - the node that turns a Frost mage into a healer rather than a mage who sometimes heals.

nodes.name: Frozen Light
nodes.description: Casting a heal wreathes you in Frozen Light for 3 turns, increasing your healing done by 30%.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. healing_done_pct inside a status effect is the status-channel healing key, read at abilities.py:1661 in PERCENTAGE POINTS - correct here, and NOT the same as healing_done, which is talent-channel only and would be dead in this position.

nodes.name: Lesser Frozen Light
nodes.description: Your heals have a 33% chance per rank to grant Lesser Frozen Light for 2 turns, increasing your healing done by 10%.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. The multi-rank sibling of Frozen Light, ranked by chance - which is the only thing a talent proc can scale with points.

MANDATORY: the ONLY unlock for mage_icy_penance, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Frostfall
nodes.description: Teaches Frostfall, calling icy stars that damage every enemy and heal your whole party.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW CRYOTHERAPIST, preserved exactly through the Frost rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, proc, values, tier, column, links and icon_id. NOT a WotLK talent. The whole branch was verified live before anything was touched: cryo_convert_frostbolt and cryo_convert_ice_lance are read at character.py:1928 and turn the mage's nukes into smart-heals; on_heal_cast and on_damage_cast are real triggers; smart_heal is a real payload; healing_done_pct inside a status effect is read at abilities.py:1661. nodes.name: Blizzard
nodes.description: Teaches Blizzard, pelting an area with ice over several turns.
nodes._source: Kept - the ONLY unlock for mage_blizzard, which is requires_talent. Blizzard is a TRAINED spell in real 3.3.5a rather than a talent, so this node is a Frontier addition; it stays because dropping it would strand the ability. Improved Blizzard IS a real Frost talent (row 1) but adds a Chill effect, which does not exist, so it is not built.
